title: Field Engagement Trends and Omnichannel KPIs in Life Sciences CRM
summary: Analysis of field engagement patterns across life sciences commercial teams, covering channel effectiveness metrics, video call adoption, and omnichannel engagement KPIs from industry tracking data.

findings.rep_activity_tracking: Industry tracking covers activity data for 80%+ of pharmaceutical field representatives globally. Key metrics: calls per day, reach (unique HCPs contacted), frequency (average calls per HCP), and channel mix (in-person vs. remote vs. digital).
findings.video_call_effectiveness: Video calls show approximately 3x the engagement effectiveness of traditional phone calls when measured by content engagement metrics (slides viewed, time spent, follow-up actions). However, video calls represent less than 15% of total remote interactions due to HCP scheduling constraints.
findings.omnichannel_kpi_framework: Omnichannel KPIs measure cross-channel engagement holistically: approved email open rates, content engagement scores, meeting scheduling rates, and multi-channel sequence completion. Organizations with mature omnichannel programs show 20-30% higher HCP engagement scores.
findings.channel_mix_evolution: Post-pandemic channel mix has stabilized at approximately 70% in-person, 20% remote (video + phone), and 10% digital (approved email + content portals). This varies significantly by geography — some markets maintain 50%+ remote engagement.
findings.content_engagement_metrics: Content engagement is tracked at the individual asset level: views, time-on-slide, shares, and downstream actions. High-performing content pieces show 3-5x the engagement of average content, suggesting content quality is a stronger driver than channel selection.
findings.implications_for_crm: CRM platforms need native omnichannel orchestration that suggests the right channel for each HCP based on engagement history, preference signals, and content affinity. Single-channel optimization is insufficient.

source: Industry field engagement trends analysis covering rep activity patterns, channel effectiveness, and omnichannel KPIs across life sciences commercial operations
